_note: The KARDI Christmas Party. Fill 'this_year' as details are confirmed; anything null shows as 'to be announced'. donate_url must be the beneficiary charity's own official donation page. The site never takes money itself.

ways.title: Give at the door
ways.body: Bring something for someone who needs it. The list of what to bring is below and is updated once the beneficiary confirms what they need most.

ways.title: Give online
ways.body: Donate directly to this year's charity through their own secure page. Every dollar goes to them, not through this site.

ways.title: Sponsor the night
ways.body: Brands and companies underwrite the venue, the toys and the production so the money raised goes further. Packages come with the Partners lane and the booking team.

past.note: "Free the City", co-hosted with Nelly Furtado at Muzik. Proceeds sent inner-city youth to volunteer with Me to We.

past.beneficiary: SickKids, Caribbean Paediatric Cancer and Blood Program
